notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-d (spec: drafts/content/C-STORY-review.md). One entry per Guardian through Brown/Black; Lost Lightbearer (Black) is out of scope. Each freeingKind is different. howFreed only describes existing attacks, phases and C14 form shifts; no mechanics change. Ties follow story/mystery-ladder.json (stacked on C-STORY-b, #335). Faith notes reuse the merged overlay verses, re-checked against bible-api.com (KJV). No Scripture in kid lines. Nothing shipped or existing is changed; see guardian-arcs.md for suggested line changes.

guardians.wants: It wants to keep the Tower's lamps glowing.
guardians.whyConfused: It kept the first lamp so long it forgot why. The dark didn't take its light; it took the memory of warmth.
guardians.howFreed: During Wick Wake its lamps light one by one. When it's beaten, the last lamp stays lit, and the Keeper looks at it and remembers.
guardians.freedLine: A spark... I had forgotten how warm it feels.

ladderTie.fact: It holds the Cracked Lamp Glass: the light broke, but the pieces are still here.

faithNote.text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

guardians.wants: It wants its flowers to open again.
guardians.whyConfused: The storm tangled it in thorns, and it blamed itself. Nobody broke the light on purpose.
guardians.howFreed: At its 33% glow it becomes the Bloom Gardener: the thorns fall off as it reaches for the sun. When beaten, every flower opens at once.
guardians.freedLine: The thorns are gone. The storm wasn't my fault!

ladderTie.fact: Its freed Bestiary page tells of the storm that broke the light, and that it was no one's fault.

faithNote.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

guardians.wants: It wants someone to share supper with.
guardians.whyConfused: It kept cooking for a table that stayed empty. Lonely isn't the same as forgotten.
guardians.howFreed: Its Spark Sprites stop hopping and settle into the cold ovens, which warm up again. You sit down, and it sets out bowls, plus one kept warm.
guardians.freedLine: Is it supper time? I would love some company.

ladderTie.fact: It keeps the Empty Bowl: one seat at supper was left empty on the storm night.

faithNote.text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

guardians.wants: It wants to feel brave on the inside.
guardians.whyConfused: The shadow stacked worry on worry until it looked like a giant. Underneath was someone small and scared.
guardians.howFreed: At its 33% glow the worry stones tumble off, leaving Pebble Heart. You stayed; when beaten, the last stone rolls away.
guardians.freedLine: I was stones and worry. Thank you for staying!

ladderTie.fact: Its older-reader page says the shadow is many small fears stacked up, not one monster.

faithNote.text: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.

guardians.wants: It wants clear water, so it can see its friends.
guardians.whyConfused: Muddy water made every shape look like a stranger. It isn't fierce; it couldn't see.
guardians.howFreed: Its muddy puddles stop spreading and settle. When beaten, the river goes still and clear, and it sees you for the first time.
guardians.freedLine: The water is clear. I can see you now, friend.

ladderTie.fact: On the storm night it watched someone carry the light up through the rain (Boat Log).

faithNote.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

guardians.wants: It wants to keep everyone safe.
guardians.whyConfused: It was told to guard the forge from everyone, so it guarded against the very people it was made to help.
guardians.howFreed: During Shield Rush it holds its shield up the whole time. When beaten, it lowers the shield and steps aside to let you pass.
guardians.freedLine: I was guarding the wrong thing. Shields are for helping.

ladderTie.fact: It knows the Cracked Shield: someone used a shield to cover the light, and it held.

faithNote.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

guardians.wants: It wants to hear kind words.
guardians.whyConfused: It copied every voice it heard, and in the dark the only voices said 'give up'. It needed someone to answer differently.
guardians.howFreed: It copies your moves with Echo Copy. You keep choosing your own path, and when it's beaten it echoes your kind words, not the shadow's.
guardians.freedLine: I copied what I heard. Now I hear kindness.

ladderTie.fact: It guards the Traveler's Note: one voice kept answering, 'I will hold the light until help comes.'

faithNote.text: I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

guardians.wants: It wants someone to read its books with.
guardians.whyConfused: It kept every story safe and forgot that stories are for sharing. One page in its library belongs to an old student.
guardians.howFreed: Its Page Flutters stop swirling and land in your hands. When beaten, the root ring opens wide and it hands you a book.
guardians.freedLine: Take a book, little one. Your story belongs here too.

ladderTie.fact: Its library holds the Student Sash page: the carrier was once a student who trained these same forms.

faithNote.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

guardians.wants: It wants to be heard over the storm.
guardians.whyConfused: It shouted louder and louder so no one would notice it was scared. Under the noise, it was listening for one voice.
guardians.howFreed: At its 33% glow it shrinks into the Quiet Thunderhead. When beaten, the thunder stops, and in the calm you both hear someone calling.
guardians.freedLine: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.

ladderTie.fact: Its calm leads into Sensei's reveal: Sensei trained with the carrier long ago and kept hoping they'd come home.

faithNote.text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
